subject: POC trial RACI & stakeholder mapping - VeridianHealth
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Kyle Jensen <kyle.jensen@veridianhealth.com>, Aisha Wu <aisha.wu@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: POC trial RACI & stakeholder mapping - VeridianHealth

Hi Kyle / Aisha —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps to get the POC trial scoped and scheduled. Goal is to capture success criteria, evaluation plan, timelines, and RACI so procurement / security can move quickly.

Call highlights:
- Use case: inference for chart summarization and clinician triage (batch + low-latency API).
- Target dataset: 3 months of de-identified notes (~300k tokens/day peak).
- Success criteria (draft): >=95% availability during peak hours, median latency <120ms for 512-token requests, cost per 1k tokens < $X (TBD), and qualitative accuracy on 10 prompt sets (baseline vs Redwood).

Proposed timeline:
- Week 1 (Aug 9-13): finalize scope, security questionnaire kickoff, agree on dataset delivery method.
- Week 2 (Aug 16-20): infra/config provisioning (Dedicated pool), baseline runs on sample data.
- Week 3 (Aug 23-27): validation, SLA smoke tests, and first evaluation report.
- Week 4 (Aug 30-Sep 3): stakeholder review and decision meeting.

RACI (proposed) — high level:
- Veridian app owner: Aisha Wu (responsible)
- Veridian security/compliance: Kyle Jensen (consulted for SOC2/data handling)
- Procurement / contracts: Amy Lee (external) (informed on pricing and SOW)
- Redwood infra provisioning: Marissa Cole (account lead) / lauren_bishop (engineering PM) (responsible for provisioning + runbook)
- Redwood security engagement: aditya_rao (security lead) (consulted)

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Please confirm the names above for RACI and any other stakeholders to loop in (legal, SSO admin, CISO).
2) Can you share a point-of-contact and email for procurement to start SOW/pricing?
3) If security needs a pre-signed NDA or any specific forms, flag now — we can prioritize.

Attachments: draft POC scope (veridian_poc_scope.docx) and initial Redwood config (redwood_poc_config.yml).

I can set up a 30-min follow-up next Tue (Aug 10) to lock timelines — ping me times that work.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Cc: Amy Lee <amy.lee@veridianhealth.com>

Subject: Re: POC trial RACI & stakeholder mapping - VeridianHealth

Thanks Marissa — good summary. A couple quick notes:

- Confirming RACI: I am the security/compliance lead for this initiative (consulted). Aisha is the app owner and will own dataset collection. Amy (cc'd) is procurement — Amy, can you confirm preferred contracting cadence and when you can review the SOW?
- Timeline looks reasonable; we prefer a one-week buffer for procurement sign-off, so if provisioning starts Aug 16 that's fine.
- We will also need a list of exact IPs and endpoint URLs for firewall whitelisting once provisioning is scheduled.

Amy: looping you in — our procurement lead handles MSA review and standard redlines.

One ask from security: Aditya (from Redwood) mentioned SOC2 evidence on the call — can you send the SOC2 attestation and details on encryption at rest? If possible, send the SOC2 report or a pointer to the compliance package.

Happy to meet Aug 10; morning PT works for me (8:30-10:00).
—Kyle
Kyle Jensen
Director, IT Security | Veridian Health
kyle.jensen@veridianhealth.com | +1 (212) 555-0113

- I'll own coordination with procurement (Amy) and get SOW template started.

Also attaching the draft scope — feel free to propose edits to the success criteria; we'll finalize in the follow-up with Veridian next Tue.

Thanks,
Marissa
